## About

AxeomLabs is an Indian deep-tech company designing and building autonomous systems at the intersection of hardware, software, and intelligence. Founded in 2024 by Harinandan J V and Abhishek A S.

## Products & Divisions

- **Drones (Aerial Systems):** Custom-engineered UAVs for surveillance, mapping, and payload delivery. Designed for turbulent environments with LiDAR-based navigation.
- **Robotics:** Humanoid and ground robots with tactile sensing, adaptive gait control, and real-time edge AI inference.
- **Systems & Embedded Software:** Bare-metal firmware, real-time operating systems (Axeom OS), and full-stack software from ARM microcontrollers to cloud fleet management.

## Research Focus

AxeomLabs conducts applied research in:
- Autonomous navigation (SLAM, visual odometry, sensor fusion)
- Computer vision for unstructured environments
- Edge AI and on-device inference
- Materials science for lightweight structural hardware
- Human-machine interaction for field robotics
